NDivisorialShells.signed_shell_reconstruction.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K] (v : ℕ → FinitePlace K)
  (b : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K → ℝ) (hp : ReviewM.PositivePartition (NDivisorialShells.descendedMask K v b))
  (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)) (d : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hd : Integrable d mu) :
  HasSum
      (fun n =>
        ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
          ↑(NDivisorialShells.descendedStratumMask K v b (n + 1) x - NDivisorialShells.descendedStratumMask K v b n x) *
            d x ∂mu)
      (∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), ↑(NDivisorialShells.descendedMask K v b none x) * d x ∂mu -
        ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), d x ∂mu) ∧
    Summable fun n =>
      ‖∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
          ↑(NDivisorialShells.descendedStratumMask K v b (n + 1) x - NDivisorialShells.descendedStratumMask K v b n x) *
            d x ∂mu‖
